svg.text: Automatic City Services · Kubernetes HA topology
Текущая topology из prod/local-ha Kustomize: реальные replica counts, failover-контуры и отмеченные SPOF

g.text: Auth · Ticket · Department · Brigade · Profile · Location · Routing
Dispatch · File · SLA · Notification · Audit · Analytics · Report · Asset
Migration and init Jobs bypass PgBouncer
Separate DB/owner: auth, department, brigade, profile
location, routing, dispatch, file, sla, notification
pgBackRest: WAL archive + differential backup → versioned MinIO postgres-backups
Реплика — не backup; restore/PITR drill обязателен
RF=3 · min ISR=2 · PVC per broker

Database/messaging core имеет failover при наличии ≥3 failure domains; production app layer пока HA только для API Gateway. Остальные Deployments ×1, ingress без закреплённого replica policy и одиночные stateful engines требуют усиления.
